string-array.name: loading_hints
string-array.item: The first run downloads the Steam client from Valve and then its update - a few minutes on a good connection.
The screen stays black until the client draws its first frame; nothing is stuck while this clock is moving.
You can leave. Steam keeps running in the background and the notification brings you back.
A controller shows up in Steam as an Xbox 360 pad. Without one, the on-screen pad appears.
Games you install go through Valve\'s own ARM64 Proton; the client fetches it the first time it is needed.

resources.string: Keeps Steam running while the app is in the background
Steam is running - leave this notification alone

Extra frames are generated between the real ones on the way to the screen, so a game running at 30 fps looks like 60. Win-FG is built in. LSFG uses the shaders from your own copy of Lossless Scaling - install it from the Steam client in this app first. Takes effect immediately, even mid-game.
